purpose: Policy, budget levels, forms and calendar for the next budget
atlas_ref: Reference C, 1. Planning and budget preparation

atlas_ref: Reference C, 1. Planning and budget preparation

identified_by: Form number, agency, program code (15 digits)
atlas_ref: Reference C, 1. Planning and budget preparation

atlas_ref: Reference C, 1. Planning and budget preparation

name: Budget of Expenditures and Sources of Financing (BESF)
purpose: Fiscal tables: assumptions, revenues, spending, financing, debt
atlas_ref: Reference C, 1. Planning and budget preparation

name: President's Budget Message
purpose: Policy and priorities of the proposed budget
atlas_ref: Reference C, 1. Planning and budget preparation

name: General Appropriations Bill (GAB)
purpose: The budget in the form of a bill
identified_by: Bill number. For FY 2027: House Bill No. 10858

name: Conference committee report
purpose: One reconciled text

name: Enrolled bill
purpose: The text sent to the President

name: General Appropriations Act (GAA)
purpose: The law that appropriates. Contains the amounts by agency and program, special provisions for agencies and funds, and general provisions for all
identified_by: Republic Act number (No. 12314 for FY 2026), then UACS codes for each line

name: Veto message
purpose: States the items vetoed

name: Release guidelines (National Budget Circular)
purpose: Rules of release for the year, with two schedules of items
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Budget Execution Documents: BED 1 Financial Plan, BED 2 Physical Plan, BED 3 Monthly Disbursement Program
purpose: Plan of obligations, outputs and payments for the year. BED 3 is the basis of the NCA
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: GAA as allotment order (GAAAO)
purpose: For items without conditions, the GAA itself is the allotment. The Manual of 2015 names a document for this release, the General Appropriations Act Release Document. The circular for 2026 does not
identified_by: None. The item is identified by its UACS code in the GAA
basis: NBC599 s.3.7, GAA2026-GP. Name in the Manual: GAM-V1 Ch.3 s.3
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Special Budget Request (SBR)
purpose: Asks DBM to release an item that needs clearance
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Special Allotment Release Order (SARO)
purpose: Releases an allotment for a specific purpose
identified_by: SARO number, with UACS codes. Example of a number: SARO-BMB-B-26-0000189
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: General Allotment Release Order (GARO)
purpose: Releases an allotment to all agencies for a common purpose, for example retirement and life insurance premiums
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Notice of Cash Allocation (NCA)
purpose: Maximum amount that the agency may pay from an MDS sub-account in a period. The agency records it by a journal entry and in its registry of the NCA. It issues no official receipt for it, because no money is received
basis: NBC599, GAM-V1 Ch.5 s.38, Ch.6 s.3
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Advice of NCA Issued
purpose: Tells the agency that an NCA was issued
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Non-Cash Availment Authority (NCAA)
purpose: Covers loan or grant proceeds used by direct payment, supplier's credit or constructive cash
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Cash Disbursement Ceiling (CDC)
purpose: Lets foreign service posts use income collected abroad, within their allotment
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Tax Remittance Advice (TRA)
issuer: Agency, in the electronic filing system of BIR. The chief accountant certifies it and the head of agency approves it
purpose: Records taxes withheld as remitted to BIR without a transfer of cash. The same document is the basis of entries in three sets of books: of the agency, of BIR and of BTr
basis: NBC599 (listed). GAM-V1 Ch.5 s.38, Ch.6 s.2, ss.60-62
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Modification Advice Form (MAF)
purpose: Records an approved change inside an allotment
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Advice for use of PS Allotment (APSA)
purpose: Uses available personnel allotment for a shortage in a personnel benefit
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Multi-Year Contractual Authority (MYCA)
issuer: DBM, before any procurement activity starts
purpose: Allows an agency to enter into a contract that lasts more than one year and is paid from local funds. It states the total project cost and the amounts by year. It provides no money: the obligations of a year may not exceed the cash appropriation of that year
identified_by: MYCA number, with organization code, project name and funding source code
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Forward Obligational Authority (FOA)
purpose: A statement of DBM that funds will be provided in the budget for a project financed by a foreign loan
basis: MC51, ODA. Content of the document: GK
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Sub-allotment advice
purpose: Passes part of an allotment to a lower unit
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Notice of Transfer of Allocation
purpose: Covers the cash requirements of its regional and operating units. The receiving unit keeps a registry for it. The circular for 2026 does not mention this document. Its usual abbreviation is the same as that of the National Tax Allotment, so this atlas writes it in full
atlas_ref: Reference C, 3. Release of allotment and cash authority

name: Project Procurement Management Plan (PPMP)
purpose: Needs of one unit for the year: buy or do the work with own staff, kind and quantity, mode, schedule, estimated budget, specifications
identified_by: Number of the plan, unit and fiscal year

name: Annual Procurement Plan (APP), indicative and final
issuer: The procurement unit consolidates the plans of the units. The BAC recommends, and the head of the procuring entity approves
purpose: All planned procurement of the year. No procurement may be made that is not in accordance with it. The final plan is posted on the website of the agency and sent to the GPPB by the end of January, since 2026 through an online form
identified_by: Line of the plan, with the title of the project and the source of funds in words. The form of 2025 has no column for a budget code. The form of 2015 began with a column "Code (PAP)"

name: Purchase Request, App.60
issuer: Requesting office, after the property unit found that the item is not in stock
purpose: Asks for the purchase of stated items
identified_by: Request number. It quotes the responsibility center code
basis: GAM-V2 App.60, GAM-V1 Ch.8 s.13. Also a BTMS record: CL2025-8

name: Invitation to bid and bidding documents
purpose: Announce the procurement and its rules. The invitation states the approved budget for the contract and the source of funding
basis: RA12009, IRR12009 s.47, s.50. Reference number: GK

name: Bid
purpose: Two sealed envelopes: the technical part and the financial part. Eligibility is shown by the registration in PhilGEPS and further statements

name: Resolution of the BAC recommending award
purpose: Recommends the winning bidder to the head of the procuring entity. It goes with the abstract of bids and with the "Document issued by the appropriate entity authorizing the Procuring Entity to incur obligations for a specified amount"

name: Notice of award
purpose: Informs the winning bidder

name: Performance security
purpose: Guarantees performance of the contract. It is posted before the contract is signed

name: Certificate of availability of funds
purpose: States that funds are available for the contract. The law requires it before the contract is entered into, and it becomes a part of the contract. On a purchase order it is a signed line at the foot of the form, with the number, date and amount of the obligation request
basis: PD1445 s.86, EO292-B6 s.40, GAM-V1 Ch.10 s.47, GAM-V2 App.61

name: Contract or Purchase Order, App.61
issuer: Head of the procuring entity and supplier
purpose: Creates the legal commitment. The Manual says that the purchase order serves as the contract between the agency and the supplier
identified_by: Contract or purchase order number. The purchase order quotes the ORS number

name: Notice to proceed
purpose: Starts the contract period

name: Framework agreement
issuer: Procuring entity, with one supplier or with several
purpose: An option contract for one, two or three years. It fixes the terms and the prices of later orders. The entity may order or not. No certificate of availability of funds is needed for it

name: Call-Off
purpose: The purchase order under a framework agreement. Each one needs a certificate of availability of funds

name: Variation order for works, amendment to order for goods
issuer: Approved by the head of the procuring entity
purpose: Changes the contract after the award. An increase may not exceed 10 percent of the original contract price, or 20 percent in the cases that the rules name

name: Observers' report
purpose: Reports on the conduct of the procurement, to the head of the procuring entity, to PhilGEPS and to COA

name: Obligation Request and Status (ORS), App.11
issuer: The requesting office prepares it and signs Box A. The budget unit assigns the number and signs Box B
purpose: Charges an amount to an allotment. Fields: payee, responsibility center, particulars, program (MFO/PAP), UACS object code, amount. Part C is the record of this one obligation, with three amounts: obligation, payable and payment
identified_by: Serial number: allotment class, funding source code, year, month, serial. One series for each fund cluster and year
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Notice of Obligation Request and Status Adjustment (NORSA), App.12
issuer: Accounting unit, after it processed the claim
purpose: Changes the amount or the codes of an obligation to the actual ones. The budget unit posts it in the obligation request and in the registry
identified_by: Serial number. It quotes the number of the obligation request and of a journal entry voucher
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Budget Utilization Request and Status (BURS), App.14
purpose: The same as the obligation request, for money that needs no allotment of DBM: retained income, revolving funds, trust receipts
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Delivery receipt
purpose: Accompanies the goods. The property custodian signs it as received
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Invoice, billing, statement of work accomplished
purpose: Claims payment. A contractor of works may submit a statement of work accomplished once a month
identified_by: Supplier's number. The acceptance report has a field for the invoice number
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Inspection and Acceptance Report (IAR), App.62
issuer: The property custodian prepares it. The inspection officer or committee signs the part for inspection. The property custodian signs the part for acceptance
purpose: States that the delivery was inspected, and that it was accepted in full or in part. The accounting unit records the payable from its copy
identified_by: Report number. It quotes the number and date of the purchase order, the invoice number and the responsibility center
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Disbursement Voucher (DV), App.32
issuer: The requesting office prepares it. The accounting unit assigns the number
purpose: Approves one claim for payment. It has five boxes. A: the supervisor certifies that the expense is necessary and lawful. B: the accounting entry. C: the head of the accounting unit certifies that cash is available and that the documents are complete. D: the head of agency approves. E: the payee acknowledges the payment
identified_by: DV number: fund cluster, year, month, serial. It quotes the ORS number. After payment it also carries the number of the check or payment order, of the official receipt and of the journal entry voucher
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Journal Entry Voucher (JEV), App.36
issuer: Accounting staff prepares it. The head of the accounting unit certifies it
purpose: Records one transaction in the books by double entry. It is used for every transaction: receipts, payments, and entries without cash
identified_by: JEV number, fund cluster, responsibility center, accounts with their UACS object codes
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: List of Due and Demandable Accounts Payable with Advice to Debit Account (LDDAP-ADA), App.42
issuer: Part I: the head of the accounting unit certifies, the head of agency approves. Part II: the cash unit signs, the head of agency countersigns
purpose: The payment order to the servicing bank. One line per payee: creditor, bank account, ORS number, allotment class, gross amount, tax withheld, net amount. Head: fund cluster, bank branch and MDS sub-account. Filled forms that agencies published also show an NCA number in the head
identified_by: Number: funding source code, month, serial, year. One series for each year
basis: GAM-V2 App.42, GAM-V1 Ch.6 s.51, s.56, LDDAP-FORM, CL2013-16A
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Summary of LDDAP-ADAs Issued and Invalidated ADA Entries (SLIIE), App.53
issuer: The cash unit prepares it each day. On the form of the Manual the head of the cash unit certifies it. The circular of 2013 names the head of accounting. The head of agency approves
purpose: Lists the payment orders of the day by allotment class, and the entries of earlier orders that were invalidated. It is addressed to the bank manager. The bank passes a copy to BTr on the same day
basis: GAM-V2 App.53, GAM-V1 Ch.6 s.56, CL2013-16A
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: MDS check, with the Advice of Checks Issued and Cancelled (ACIC), App.39
issuer: Cash unit. An authorized official countersigns the check
purpose: Payment by check. The advice goes to the bank at least once a day, so that the payees can cash the checks. Head of the advice: bank account, organization code, fund cluster, NCA number. Per check: number, date, payee, amount, UACS object code
identified_by: Check number. Number of the advice
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Report of Checks Issued (RCI), App.35, and Report of ADA Issued (RADAI), App.13
issuer: Cashier or disbursing officer, each day, on oath
purpose: Lists each check or payment order. Per line: date and serial number, DV or payroll number, ORS number, responsibility center, payee, UACS object code, amount. Copies go to the COA auditor, to the accounting unit and to the budget unit
basis: GAM-V2 App.13, App.35, GAM-V1 Ch.6 s.10, s.56
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Payroll, App.33
issuer: Who prepares it: GK. An authorized official certifies Box A, the head of the accounting unit certifies Box B, the head of agency approves in Box C, the disbursing officer certifies Box D
purpose: List of employees with compensation, deductions and net amount. Box A: the services were rendered. Box B: the documents are complete and cash is available. Box D: each employee was paid
identified_by: Payroll number. It quotes the ORS number and the JEV number
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Petty Cash Voucher, App.48
issuer: Requestor, immediate supervisor, petty cash custodian
purpose: Pays a small expense from the petty cash fund. The Manual of 2015 allows not more than PHP 15,000 for one transaction. I did not check whether a later rule changed this amount
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Liquidation Report, App.44
issuer: The officer who received a cash advance. The immediate supervisor and the head of the accounting unit certify
purpose: Shows how a cash advance was spent, what was refunded and what is still to be reimbursed
identified_by: Serial number. It quotes the DV number of the advance and the number of the official receipt of the refund
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Report of Checks Issued and Report of Cash Disbursements of an implementing agency
issuer: The agency that received a transfer of funds, within ten days after each month or agreed period
purpose: Shows how the transferred money was spent. The source agency records its expense from this report
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Order of Payment, App.28, and official receipt
issuer: The head of the accounting unit signs the order. The collecting officer issues the receipt
purpose: The order tells the collecting officer to issue a receipt to a payor for a stated bill. The receipt acknowledges the payment
identified_by: Serial number of the order. Serial number of the receipt
basis: GAM-V2 App.28, GAM-V1 Ch.5 s.40, PD1445 s.68
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Report of Collections and Deposits, App.26
issuer: Collecting officer, at the close of each business day, on oath
purpose: Lists every official receipt in the order of the numbers, with payor, program and amount by account code, and the deposits
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: Goods received note, purchase order, obligation request, revenue voucher, revenue receipt voucher
purpose: The same events, as records created one from the other
atlas_ref: Reference C, 5. Obligation, verification and payment

name: RAPAL, Registry of Appropriations and Allotments, App.8
purpose: The budget of the agency and all allotments received, by program and allotment class. Its reference column holds the number of the budget law, SARO or GARO
basis: GAM-V1 Ch.3 s.8, GAM-V2 App.8, JC2019-1

name: RAOD, Registries of Allotments, Obligations and Disbursements, App.9A to 9D
purpose: One registry for each allotment class: allotments, obligations, unobligated allotments, disbursements, and unpaid obligations in two columns: due and demandable, and not yet due and demandable
identified_by: Fund cluster, program, UACS object code. The reference column holds the date and serial number of each document
basis: GAM-V1 Ch.3 s.10, GAM-V2 App.9A, JC2019-1

name: RBUD, Registries of Budget, Utilization and Disbursements, App.10A to 10D
purpose: The same for money that needs no allotment of DBM: retained income, revolving funds, trust receipts

name: Registries of Revenue and Other Receipts, App.7
purpose: Revenue estimated, collected, and remitted or deposited

name: RANCA, Registry of Allotments and Notice of Cash Allocation, App.30
purpose: Allotment received, NCA received, NCA used. Two balances: NCA not yet used, and allotment not yet covered by an NCA. The certificate that cash is available is given from this registry
identified_by: Fund cluster. The reference column holds the number and date of each voucher
basis: GAM-V2 App.30, GAM-V1 Ch.6 s.3, ss.5-6, s.12

name: Checks and ADA Disbursements Record, App.34
purpose: Each NCA received, each check and each payment order, with the remaining balance of the NCA or of the bank account
identified_by: Bank account. Per line: number of the NCA, voucher or payroll, and serial number of the check or payment order
basis: GAM-V2 App.34, GAM-V1 Ch.6 s.10, s.52

name: Index of Payments, App.38
purpose: One sheet for each payee, with every payment to this payee. The staff reads it before a claim is paid, to find an earlier payment of the same claim
identified_by: Payee. Per line: number of the voucher or payroll, then of the check or payment order

name: Bank Reconciliation Statement, App.80 for MDS accounts and App.81 for accounts in depository banks
issuer: Chief accountant or designated staff, each month, for each bank account
purpose: Compares the balance in the books with the balance in the bank statement, and lists the items that explain the difference, for example checks not yet presented and a lapsed NCA
basis: GAM-V1 Ch.21, GAM-V2 App.80, App.81, PD1445 s.74

name: BAR 1, Quarterly Physical Report of Operations
purpose: Actual outputs against the physical plan

name: FAR 1, Statement of Appropriations, Allotments, Obligations, Disbursements and Balances, with 1-A (by object), 1-B (list of allotments and sub-allotments), 1-C (inter-agency fund transfers)
purpose: The main budget execution report. Certified by the budget officer and the chief accountant, approved by the head of agency

name: FAR 2 and 2-A
purpose: Approved budget, utilization and disbursements of off-budget funds (fund clusters 05 and 06)

name: FAR 3, Aging of Due and Demandable Obligations
purpose: Unpaid obligations by age, once a year

name: FAR 4, Monthly Report of Disbursements
purpose: Payments by type of disbursement authority

name: FAR 5, Quarterly Report of Revenue and Other Receipts
purpose: Receipts of fund clusters 01 to 07

name: FAR 6
purpose: Approved budget, utilization and disbursements of trust receipts (fund cluster 07)

name: Trial balance and the six financial statements: financial position, financial performance, changes in net assets or equity, cash flows, comparison of budget and actual amounts, and notes
issuer: Accounting unit. The budget unit prepares the statement of comparison, and the accounting unit verifies its actual amounts
purpose: Position and results of the agency on the accrual basis, and the comparison with the budget on the budget basis

name: Annual Financial Report
purpose: Consolidated statements of the government

name: Cash Operations Report
purpose: Revenue, disbursements, surplus or deficit and financing of the national government

name: Agency Performance Review
purpose: Yearly review of the results of each agency against the targets in the budget law

name: Status of the national disaster fund
purpose: Appropriation, each release with SARO number, date and amount, and balance

name: Consolidated Public Sector Financial Position
issuer: DOF, as a table in the budget documents
purpose: Surplus or deficit of the national government, monitored corporations, social security institutions, the central bank, government financial institutions and local governments, added into one balance

name: Fiscal Risks Statement
purpose: Names the events that would make revenue, spending or debt differ from the program

name: Entry in the COMPASS portal
issuer: Each covered agency submits. DBM operates the portal
purpose: Publishes budget, release, spending, project and procurement information

name: Statement of receipts and expenditures of a local government
purpose: Fiscal report to BLGF

name: Audit Observation Memorandum
purpose: States a finding and asks for comment

name: Notice of Suspension
purpose: Suspends an amount until a requirement is met

name: Notice of Disallowance
purpose: Disallows an expenditure and names the persons liable

name: Notice of Charge
purpose: Charges a shortage in revenue to the persons liable

name: Notice of Settlement of Suspensions, Disallowances and Charges
purpose: Records that a finding was settled

name: Statement of Audit Suspensions, Disallowances and Charges
purpose: Quarterly list of open findings

name: Notice of Finality of Decision
purpose: States that a decision is final

name: COA Order of Execution
purpose: Orders the collection of a final liability

name: Audit report of the agency
purpose: Opinion on the statements, observations and recommendations
basis: PD1445 s.43 (a report of audit for each year). Content: GK

name: Stock Card, App.58, and Supplies Ledger Card, App.57
issuer: The property unit keeps the stock card, in quantities. The accounting unit keeps the ledger card, in quantities and cost
purpose: Record each kind of supply. The two records are reconciled
basis: GAM-V1 Ch.8 s.9, GAM-V2 App.57, App.58

name: Requisition and Issue Slip, App.63, and Report of Supplies and Materials Issued, App.64
issuer: The requesting office asks, the property custodian issues. The property unit and the accounting unit fill the report
purpose: The slip records one issue of supplies from stock. The report lists the slips of a period, and the accounting unit records the expense from it
identified_by: Slip number. Serial number of the report
basis: GAM-V2 App.63, App.64, GAM-V1 Ch.8 s.16, Annex H

name: Property Card, App.69, and Property, Plant and Equipment Ledger Card, App.70
issuer: The property unit keeps the property card. The accounting unit keeps the ledger card
purpose: The card shows receipt, issue, transfer, disposal and balance. The ledger card shows cost, depreciation, impairment and repairs. The two records are reconciled
identified_by: Property number, assigned by the property unit. Object account code on the ledger card
basis: GAM-V2 App.69, App.70, GAM-V1 Ch.10 s.42

name: Property Acknowledgment Receipt, App.71
issuer: The property custodian issues it, the user signs it
purpose: Makes a named user responsible for an item of property, plant and equipment: unit cost of PHP 50,000 or more since 2022. Renewed every three years, or when the custodian changes
identified_by: Receipt number: year, month, serial. It carries the property number

name: Inventory Custodian Slip, App.59
issuer: Property unit, signed by the user
purpose: The same for semi-expendable property below PHP 50,000

name: Report on the Physical Count of Property, Plant and Equipment, App.73
issuer: The inventory committee certifies, the head of agency approves, the representative of COA verifies
purpose: Result of the yearly count as at 31 December, sent to the auditor not later than 31 January. Per item: property number, quantity by the card and by the count, shortage or overage

name: Report on the Physical Count of Inventories, App.66
purpose: Result of the count of supplies, every six months

name: Construction in Progress Ledger Card, App.77
issuer: Accounting unit, one card for each project
purpose: Cost of one project under construction: contractor with tax number, contract period, project cost, and each entry with its voucher or journal entry voucher

name: Property Transfer Report, App.76. Inventory and Inspection Report of Unserviceable Property, App.74. Report of Lost, Stolen, Damaged or Destroyed Property, App.75
purpose: Record a transfer, a disposal, or a loss
basis: GAM-V2 App.74, App.75, App.76, PD1445 s.79

purpose: Budget of a government corporation for the year

purpose: Yearly statement of the loans of the local government

purpose: Documents of a public-private partnership (chapter 19)
